subject.title: Feature: Add costCurrency config option to customize cost display currency

question: Should configured model-cost estimates stay USD-only, or should OpenClaw add a non-USD currency contract for them; if yes, what scope should own it?
rationale: The issue changes public config and cost-accounting semantics across model config, session status, persisted/API fields, telemetry/docs, and UI aggregation, so code inspection cannot choose the product contract safely.

options.title: Define model-cost currency contract
options.body: Choose per-model, per-provider, or global scope plus mixed-currency behavior before implementation.

options.title: Keep configured costs USD-only
options.body: Leave model-cost estimates as USD and rely on provider-usage billing snapshots for provider-native balances and spend units.

options.title: Add display-only preference
options.body: Allow a symbol override while explicitly documenting that stored totals remain USD-like estimates.

recommendation.title: Define model-cost currency contract
recommendation.body: Choose per-model, per-provider, or global scope plus mixed-currency behavior before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: This choice centers on the original usage-cost reporting contract and public config/accounting semantics, where steipete has the strongest history signal from the sampled files.
